sections.A: Knee OA mein poora ghutna mutasir hota hai: cartilage, haddi, ligaments aur muscles. Yeh lambi bimari hai lekin exercise se behtar hoti hai.
sections.B: Chalne, seerhiyon, ghutne tekne aur kursi se uthne par dard, aaraam se behtar, aur subah thori der ka akdan.
sections.C: Dard kahan aur kab hota hai, subah ka akdan kitni der, aur kya sujan ya lock hona hai.
sections.D: Ghutne ki seedh (tedhi taangein), sujan, muscles ka sukhna, chaal, joint line dabana aur range.
sections.E: Koi aik test knee OA confirm nahi karta. Umar, dard ka pattern, crepitus aur haddi ka barhna milkar clinical diagnosis banate hain; aksar imaging ki zaroorat nahi.
sections.F: Patellofemoral pain (kam umar), meniscus tear (lock hona) aur gout ya infection isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Garam laal sooja ghutna aur bukhar (infection), achanak garam sooja dard (gout ya khoon), ya pindli mein sujan (DVT): urgent refer.
sections.H: 45 saal se zyada, kaam se barhne wala dard, subah ka akdan 30 minute se kam: clinical diagnosis knee OA.
sections.I: Knee mobilisation aur soft tissue kaam se thori der ka aaraam, hamesha exercise ke saath.
sections.J: Exercise pehli line ka ilaaj hai: quadriceps aur hip ki taaqat, aerobic activity, aur wazan zyada ho to kam karna.
sections.K: Garmi ya thand aur TENS optional. Ultrasound aur laser recommend nahi.
sections.L: Clinical diagnosis confirm karein, aasaan alfaaz mein samjhayein, goal banayein, 6 se 12 hafte exercise, phir khud sambhalna.
sections.M: Dard, KOOS ya WOMAC, 30-second chair stand, TUG, chalne ki bardasht aur range dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 63 saal ki teacher ko 18 mahine se dono ghutnon mein seerhiyon par dard hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: education, exercise aur zaroorat ho to wazan kam karna.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
